applicationInfo.name: ThreatForest
applicationInfo.description:
### Summary
AI-driven threat modeling platform that generates attack trees from project documentation using MITRE ATT&CK framework integration.

### Key objectives
- Automate threat modeling through AI analysis
- Generate comprehensive attack trees for security threats
- Map attack paths to MITRE ATT&CK techniques
- Provide actionable mitigation recommendations
- Enable interactive threat visualization

### Use-cases
- Analyze project documentation for security threats
- Generate attack trees from ThreatComposer files
- Map threats to industry-standard attack techniques
- Create interactive security dashboards
- Integrate with IDE workflows for live threat analysis

### Features
- Multi-provider AI model support (AWS Bedrock, Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini, Ollama)
- Intelligent context analysis using Strands framework
- Attack tree generation with step-by-step paths
- MITRE ATT&CK technique mapping via semantic similarity
- Interactive HTML dashboards with vis-network
- Kiro IDE integration for real-time analysis
- State management with workflow resumption
